name: c3-m1
idea_origin: Mejora line, 29 Oct: v4 story rules (through ex-v1) plus the part of t13-read-v9 that improved the DeepSeek L1 bank (hidden social and time costs in the review months), without v9's global relaxation of the risk list
operator: mv-4 (= mv-3's Skill + the 'never end a reply with text only' manifest line) unchanged except two starting-level grafts from the Corte 3 line: (1) the quarter at the starting level buys one point of Health (enough to pass 3 when lower) and spends the rest on the review, instead of all Energy on Health while Health is 5 or below (6/19 vs 9/11 first promotions in real careers); (2) c3-k5's stalled-start protocol (no added risk, prefer risk-lowering, then keep S/N/O; quarterly Defuse first), the order behind the only third-review rescues in faithful segments (3 of 8).
hypothesis: mv-3/4's mid-game (6 complete careers, mean 68.1) with fewer starting-level dismissals.
predicted_behaviour: 3 of 3 DeepInfra probes paired; in games <= 3 text-only replies.
refutation: Probes unpaired, or games with as many stops as mv-3.
change: mv-3 -> mv-4: manifest instruction, after 'Never send take_action alone and never observe in a reply of its own.', adds 'Never end a reply with text only: until the run is over, every reply carries its tool calls, so put the decision in the take_action call, not in prose.'
notes: Built 1 Nov after Alejandro pointed at mv-3 as the best manual so far.
